announcements.title: Titankin & Boss Rush update
announcements.body:
Titankin's Overdrive moves are stronger: the Enhanced Heal heals more than double, and the Enhanced Skill staggers the boss. They still follow cooldowns, so plan your turns.
Fixed: Who Towards Death now ambushes the last attacker in online Boss Rush.

announcements.title: Huge update!
announcements.body:
Online battles are here: host a room, share the code and fight a friend or team up against hard bosses.
You can now see your opponent's skin and aura.
New in Settings: screen shake and a two-level low detail mode. 
New in Audio: you can now import your own music as background music. 
New attack animations/effects in character's skins

announcements.title: Welcome to the Arena
announcements.body: Thanks for playing! Announcements will show up here.
